description: ES256 with a kid that two P-256 members carry fails with MultipleMatchingKeys; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 and §2.5: both members are P-256 with kid dup and neither has alg, use or key_ops, so two match (§4); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
